# DESK-21 — Wise AI workspace

Screenshots were captured from the running app at `/matters/matter-john/messages` using the same desktop viewport (1280 × 720).

- **Before:** `before-wise-ai-panel.png`, captured from the unmodified `origin/dev` baseline at `d341ef4`.
- **After:** `after-wise-ai-next-steps.png` and `after-wise-ai-general-questions.png`, captured from `feat/desk-21-wise-ai-workspace`.

The update makes the assistant entry point forest green, bounds the drawer, keeps matter context and topic navigation in the header, labels preset prompts, and fixes the question composer to the bottom of the panel. The attorney handoff remains a secondary action that opens a reviewable message draft; it does not send a message.
